posts.t: Mattias Samuelsson just fought Hunter McDonald after he laid an open ice hit on Ryan McLeod. I believe that's Samuelsson's first career fight. Handled himself well.

Samuelsson goes after Hunter McDonald, a Fairport native, after McDonald lays a hit on McLeod in the neutral zone.

Samuelsson gets two for instigating, five for fighting, and a 10-minute misconduct. McDonald gets five for fighting.

Fight!

Samuelsson and Hunter McDonald, the local guy. That scrap broke up a Flyers scoring chance going the other way. Samuelsson gets the instigator. McDonald flattened McLeod in open ice and Samuelsson took exception
Noel Acciari hurting after blocking a Samuelsson shot, hobbled off the ice and went down the tunnel.
A very warm ovation for Mattias Samuelsson announced for playing in his 300th game. Still incredible a couple seasons ago that he was booed for playing in his 200th game
Mattias Samuelsson scores, and the Sabres have tied the game in the third. The third period has been kind to the Sabres this season.
